w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 24 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
Someone walks in like they belong here, grinning. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to see it." The System's show has an audience, and audiences talk.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Peepal Fig. Peepal. The tree the Buddha sat under — its figs feed birds, and you in a pinch. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/11/4), with 6 wave-4 fought, 11 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Rosa Mendez did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
